sinopsis.es: Dos jóvenes periodistas, Kevin y Sara, investigan a un empresario chino que perjudica a pescadores artesanales. A dos semanas de las elecciones presencian su reunión con Méndez, el candidato que lidera las encuestas, mientras su editor les pide cubrir los mítines.
sinopsis.en: Two young journalists, Kevin and Sara, investigate a Chinese businessman who is harming artisanal fishermen. Two weeks before the elections they witness his meeting with Méndez, the candidate leading the polls, while their editor asks them to cover the rallies.
